name: flagLaborValue
description: Klassifiziert Laborwerte anhand von Referenz- und kritischen Grenzen einschließlich Einheit und verständlicher Kennzeichnung.

name: formatQuantity
source: export function formatQuantity(params) { return params.magnitude == null ? "" : `${params.magnitude}${params.unit ? ` ${params.unit}` : ""}`; }

name: isOutOfRange
description: Checks a numeric value against optional reference bounds.
source: export function isOutOfRange(params) { return (params.low != null && params.value < params.low) || (params.high != null && params.value > params.high); }

name: latestByCode
description: Finds the most recent AQL row for a LOINC code.
source: export function latestByCode(params) { return (params.rows || []).filter((row) => row.loincCode === params.code).sort((a, b) => String(b.recordedAt || "").localeCompare(String(a.recordedAt || "")))[0] || null; }

name: assessAdministration
description: Bewertet eine geplante Medikamentengabe zeitlich und berücksichtigt eine erforderliche Doppelkontrolle.

name: activeNames
description: Extracts medication names from result rows.
source: export function activeNames(params) { return [...new Set((params.rows || []).filter((row) => row.status !== "stopped").map((row) => row.medicationName).filter(Boolean))]; }

name: hasIngredient
description: Checks medication rows for an ingredient substring.
source: export function hasIngredient(params) { const needle = String(params.ingredient || "").toLowerCase(); return (params.rows || []).some((row) => String(row.medicationName || row.ingredient || "").toLowerCase().includes(needle)); }

name: summary
source: export function summary(params) { return [params.medicationName, params.dose, params.route, params.frequency].filter(Boolean).join(" · "); }

name: validateIdentityConsistency
description: Vergleicht Patientenidentitäten aus Aktenkopf und Vorbelegung und liefert einen blockierenden Sicherheitsstatus bei Widerspruch.

name: ageAt
description: Calculates age in full years at an ISO date.
source: export function ageAt(params) { const birth = new Date(params.birthDate); const at = new Date(params.at || Date.now()); let age = at.getUTCFullYear() - birth.getUTCFullYear(); const beforeBirthday = at.getUTCMonth() < birth.getUTCMonth() || (at.getUTCMonth() === birth.getUTCMonth() && at.getUTCDate() < birth.getUTCDate()); return Number.isFinite(age) ? age - (beforeBirthday ? 1 : 0) : null; }

name: contactSummary
description: Formats available address and contact fields.
source: export function contactSummary(params) { return [params.street, [params.postalCode, params.city].filter(Boolean).join(" "), params.phone].filter(Boolean).join(" · "); }

name: displayName
description: Creates a display name from a patient record.
source: export function displayName(params) { return [params.title, params.givenName, params.familyName].filter(Boolean).join(" "); }

name: assessDirtyState
description: Ermittelt, ob ein Formular gegenüber dem geladenen Ausgangszustand verändert wurde und ob Verwerfen bestätigt werden muss.
